recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-12325 unless a later work-group decision intentionally retires the DSTU2/STU3 transition guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-12325 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core-http. It raised that STU3's switch from returning Conformance to returning CapabilityStatement from GET [base]/metadata could break existing clients, and the approved resolution was to add a cross-version client compatibility note rather than define a new endpoint.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 0f6f410a49eb2d258cd3e6387f9350854963e74a, titled '#12325 - note about change to /metadata return resource' and tied to svn revision 10274. That commit added the implementation note that clients using the capabilities interaction for version or feature checks should handle either Conformance or CapabilityStatement.
additional_context: FHIR-9645 is the background rename from Conformance to CapabilityStatement. The current source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini entries show source/http.html is the active RESTful API page, and later HTTP-page updates including fhirVersion metadata guidance do not supersede the FHIR-12325 compatibility note. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record for the seed issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. The current source already satisfies the Jira resolution, and adding a /capabilities endpoint or duplicating warning text elsewhere would exceed the accepted modification.

related_jiras.note: Published rename from Conformance to CapabilityStatement; it is the background change that made FHIR-12325's client compatibility note necessary.
Published multi-version metadata clarification and nearby fhirVersion guidance; it does not change or supersede the FHIR-12325 note.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Not Persuasive with Modification issue asking how to avoid breaking clients when /metadata changed from returning Conformance to CapabilityStatement.
evidence_items.learned: The final decision was to add a cross-version client compatibility note and tell clients to handle both resource names, not to add a new endpoint.

evidence_items.summary: The capabilities interaction includes an implementation note stating that DSTU2 and earlier returned Conformance and clients should process either Conformance or CapabilityStatement.
evidence_items.learned: The current source already implements the approved compatibility guidance.
